Find a gas station in Manhattan, NY with a rating above 4.0, and sort the user reviews by the lowest rating.

Rules:
- Work entirely in this one browser tab. Do NOT open new tabs.
- Do NOT use a search engine (Google, Bing, etc.) or cached/archived copies (e.g. web.archive.org). Navigate the site itself, starting from https://www.google.com/maps/.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.
